title: X0 Bot: black on coral, curious
subtitle: The soft-matte Peek-a-bot as a deep-black matte head on coral. The gloss-black visor reads against the matte, and the warm eyes glance up toward the antenna tip: the bigger eye has a lifted lid-light. Ranked, strongest first. The dashed card is the Grok Bot icon, for comparison only.

black-coral-bent.title: Bent antenna
black-coral-bent.line: Tilted in from the bottom, eyes up and right, and the antenna bends toward where it is looking. One gesture that tells the whole story: it's curious.

black-coral-tilt.title: Tilted
black-coral-tilt.line: The same tilt and glance with a straight antenna. Calmer and cleaner, a little less character.

black-coral-rounds.title: Round eyes
black-coral-rounds.line: Two bright rounds of different sizes: the clearest at 29 px, but more cartoon and wide-eyed than curious.

black-coral-peek.title: Straight peek
black-coral-peek.line: Straight up with the curious glance and lid-light. Most iconic, but without the tilt the curiosity is subtle.

reference.title: Grok Bot (reference)
reference.line: Not ours: the icon the owner pointed to, shown for level and distinctness.
